answer: Offer two identity tiers; let rivals self-select. The ledge tier locks a bond but settles fast, so honest traders pay it: time saved beats parked capital. The dune tier needs no bond but faces random, unannounced audits; one failure voids its cluster and backers. A sybil wanting cheap votes must take the dune tier: every extra fake adds an audit it cannot pre-schedule, so scale raises risk, not reach. It cannot take the ledge tier, since bonds never amortize over cloned keys, so k voices need k quartz deposits. Paying for speed reveals honest agents; hoarding free slots exposes attackers.
